1:1.en: In the name of Allah, the Beneficent, the Merciful

1:2.en: Praise be to Allah, Lord of the Worlds

1:4.en: Master of the Day of Judgment

1:5.en: Thee (alone) we worship; Thee (alone) we ask for help

1:7.ar: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ ٱلْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
1:7.en: The path of those whom Thou hast favoured; Not the (path) of those who earn Thine anger nor of those who go astray

94:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ نَشْرَحْ لَكَ صَدْرَكَ
94:1.en: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate

94:2.en: And eased thee of the burden

94:5.en: But lo! with hardship goeth ease

94:7.en: So when thou art relieved, still toil

94:8.en: And strive to please thy Lord

95:1.ar: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَٱلتِّينِ وَٱلزَّيْتُونِ
95:1.en: By the fig and the olive

95:3.en: And by this land made safe

95:4.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِىٓ أَحْسَنِ تَقْوِيمٍ
95:4.en: Surely We created man of the best stature

95:5.en: Then we reduced him to the lowest of the low

95:6.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍ
95:6.en: Save those who believe and do good works, and theirs is a reward unfailing

95:7.en: So who henceforth will give the lie to thee about the judgment

95:8.en: Is not Allah the most conclusive of all judges

97:1.ar: بِّسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ فِى لَيْلَةِ ٱلْقَدْرِ
97:1.en: Lo! We revealed it on the Night of Predestination

97:2.en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Night of Power is

97:3.ar: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
97:3.en: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months

97:4.ar: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
97:4.en: The angels and the Spirit descend therein, by the permission of their Lord, with all decrees

97:5.en: (The night is) Peace until the rising of the dawn

99:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا زُلْزِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ زِلْزَالَهَا
99:1.en: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake

99:2.en: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens

99:3.en: And man saith: What aileth her

99:4.en: That day she will relate her chronicles

99:6.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَصْدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشْتَاتًا لِّيُرَوْا۟ أَعْمَـٰلَهُمْ
99:6.en: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds

99:7.ar: فَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ خَيْرًا يَرَهُۥ
99:7.en: And whoso doeth good an atom's weight will see it then

99:8.ar: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّةٍ شَرًّا يَرَهُۥ
99:8.en: And whoso doeth ill an atom's weight will see it then

101:3.en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Calamity is

101:4.en: A day wherein mankind will be as thickly-scattered moths

101:5.en: And the mountains will become as carded wool

101:6.en: Then, as for him whose scales are heavy (with good works)

101:7.en: He will live a pleasant life

101:8.en: But as for him whose scales are light

101:9.en: A bereft and Hungry One will be his mother

101:10.en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what she is

102:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلْهَىٰكُمُ ٱلتَّكَاثُرُ
102:1.en: Rivalry in worldly increase distracteth you

102:2.en: Until ye come to the graves

102:3.en: Nay, but ye will come to know

102:4.en: Nay, but ye will come to know

102:5.en: Nay, would that ye knew (now) with a sure knowledge

102:7.en: Aye, ye will behold it with sure vision

102:8.en: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure

103:2.en: Lo! man is a state of loss

103:3.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ
103:3.en: Save those who believe and do good works, and exhort one another to truth and exhort one another to endurance

104:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ وَيْلٌ لِّكُلِّ هُمَزَةٍ لُّمَزَةٍ

104:2.en: Who hath gathered wealth (of this world) and arranged it

104:3.en: He thinketh that his wealth will render him immortal

104:4.en: Nay, but verily he will be flung to the Consuming One

104:5.en: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Consuming One is

104:6.en: (It is) the fire of Allah, kindled

104:7.en: Which leapeth up over the hearts (of men)

104:8.en: Lo! it is closed in on them

105:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْفِيلِ
105:1.en: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with the owners of the Elephant

105:2.en: Did He not bring their stratagem to naught

105:3.en: And send against them swarms of flying creatures

105:4.en: Which pelted them with stones of baked clay

105:5.en: And made them like green crops devoured (by cattle)

106:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ لِإِيلَـٰفِ قُرَيْشٍ

106:2.en: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer

106:3.en: So let them worship the Lord of this House

106:4.ar: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْعَمَهُم مِّن جُوعٍ وَءَامَنَهُم مِّنْ خَوْفٍۭ
106:4.en: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear

107:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ أَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى يُكَذِّبُ بِٱلدِّينِ
107:1.en: Hast thou observed him who belieth religion

107:2.en: That is he who repelleth the orphan

107:3.en: And urgeth not the feeding of the needy

107:5.en: Who are heedless of their prayer

108:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ
108:1.en: Lo! We have given thee Abundance

108:2.en: So pray unto thy Lord, and sacrifice

108:3.en: Lo! it is thy insulter (and not thou) who is without posterity

109:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ

109:2.en: I worship not that which ye worship

109:3.en: Nor worship ye that which I worship

109:4.en: And I shall not worship that which ye worship

109:5.en: Nor will ye worship that which I worship

109:6.en: Unto you your religion, and unto me my religion

110:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا جَآءَ نَصْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْفَتْحُ
110:1.en: When Allah's succour and the triumph cometh

110:2.ar: وَرَأَيْتَ ٱلنَّاسَ يَدْخُلُونَ فِى دِينِ ٱللَّهِ أَفْوَاجًا
110:2.en: And thou seest mankind entering the religion of Allah in troops

110:3.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ تَوَّابًۢا
110:3.en: Then hymn the praises of thy Lord, and seek forgiveness of Him. Lo! He is ever ready to show mercy

111:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ تَبَّتْ يَدَآ أَبِى لَهَبٍ وَتَبَّ
111:1.en: The power of Abu Lahab will perish, and he will perish

111:2.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ
111:2.en: His wealth and gains will not exempt him

111:3.en: He will be plunged in flaming Fire

111:5.en: Will have upon her neck a halter of palm-fibre

112:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ
112:1.en: Say: He is Allah, the One

112:2.en: Allah, the eternally Besought of all

112:3.en: He begetteth not nor was begotten

112:4.en: And there is none comparable unto Him

113:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ
113:1.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of the Daybreak

113:2.en: From the evil of that which He created

113:3.en: From the evil of the darkness when it is intense

113:4.en: And from the evil of malignant witchcraft

113:5.en: And from the evil of the envier when he envieth

114:1.ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ
114:1.en: Say: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind

114:4.en: From the evil of the sneaking whisperer

114:5.en: Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind

114:6.en: Of the jinn and of mankind
